name: Azel
message: 「I hear people give chocolate to convey their feelings to the one they love.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Unnecessary. Even without such things, I am perfectly capable of conveying my feelings.」

name: Azel
message: 「H-However... there is a time and place for everything. When in Rome, one must do as the Romans do.」

name: Azel
message: 「So, it is not as though I have been swayed by vulgar trends. Not at all.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph, by the way, I make no guarantees about the taste.」
